tool.name: Get.label
tool.description: label names from list, sabund, or rabund file
tool.command:
@SHELL_OPTIONS@
## create symlinks to input datasets ln -s '$otu' otu.dat &&
echo 'get.label( #if $otu.is_of_type("mothur.rabund"): rabund=otu.dat #elif $otu.is_of_type("mothur.sabund"): sabund=otu.dat #else list=otu.dat #end if )' | sed 's/ //g; s/,)$/)/' ## mothur trips over whitespace; a trailing comma segfaults mothur >1.42 | mothur | tee mothur.out.log &&
## parse relevant output from logfile to file ## extract the text mothur prints for this command from its logfile: ## everything between the echoed command and 'Output File Names:' cat mothur.*.logfile | awk '/^mothur > /{f++; next} f==1' | awk '/^Output File Names:/{f=1} !f' | awk 'NF' > '$labels_list'

param.name: otu
param.label: Input file. May be shared, sabund or rabund file

tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
**Command Documentation**
The get.label_ command generate principle components plot data.
.. _get.label: https://www.mothur.org/wiki/Get.label
v.1.20.0: Updated to Mothur 1.33
